title: RPL messages module fails strict host compilation on conversions and nullability
description: Activating a focused messages.c test exposes -Werror failures: DIO gmop and DAO kd expressions implicitly narrow int to uint8_t, and iterator data pointers lack explicit nullable/non-null annotations. Make conversions explicit and annotate iterator/raw option pointer contracts consistently; update the host shim cast and remove the old test warning suppression if applicable.
notes: Returned open/unclaimed because the user explicitly excluded C/Zephyr/AWS work from this session; no C changes from this finding remain.
